query:
SELECT count(*) AS "size!"
            FROM (
                SELECT 1
                FROM factory_run r
                WHERE r.user_id = $1
                    AND r.ended_at IS NULL
                    AND EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM factory_gate g
                        WHERE g.run_id = r.id AND g.answer IS NULL
                            AND g.stand_in_answer IS NULL
                    )
                LIMIT $2
            ) waiting
